facts.value: Exam results obtained at a university are usually only credited if they were completed no more than five calendar years before the start of the master's program.
A request for credit transfer must be submitted with the application.
Documents proving all previously obtained credits at a university must be attached to the request.
Credits from a bachelor's program cannot be credited towards the master's program.
The ranking of applicants is based on a value that consists of 60% from the grade of the required degree or preliminary average grade and 40% from the grade of the study exposé.
For the evaluation of the exposé, the motivation for study, professional aspirations, and previously acquired knowledge in business education and quantitative methods are essential.
The application is submitted online through a system provided by uni-assist e.V.
The online application allows for a paperless application process and requires all documents to be uploaded digitally.
Certified copies of required documents must be submitted only for enrollment in the new study program.
Applicants with foreign qualification certificates must demonstrate at least German language skills at the level of the Central Intermediate Examination (C1).
Every provisionally accepted applicant must take and pass the DSH-2 exam before the start of lectures.
If the evidence of completion of the bachelor's program is not provided in time, provisional acceptance will expire.
If the bachelor's certificate is not available, applicants must submit additional documentation by July 15.
All exam credits for the bachelor's program must be successfully completed in the summer semester preceding the start of the master's program.
The semester fee for the master's program is approximately 350 € per semester.
Since the winter semester 2008/09, no tuition fees are charged.
Final acceptance occurs after submission of the bachelor's certificate within a specific deadline.
Conditional acceptance may be granted with additional performance requirements from the bachelor's program if the applicant possesses an economics bachelor's degree.
